channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Two days after US voters backed data center restrictions in 40 of 41 local ballot measures, the market repriced the build: Reuters reported the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 8% on Thursday, with CoreWeave down 11% and Nebius 15%. Texas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa said she will keep the state's pause in place until the legislature passes local votes, no-NDA rules and ratepayer protections; BMI says 53% of hyperscaler pipeline growth sits in newly flipped governor states, and Cleanview counts 159 GW, or 41% of planned US capacity, where new governors back a pause. Builders are answering with terms: OpenAI pledged to drop NDAs and pay its full power cost, and Lambda named itself anchor of a $33.1 billion, 1 GW campus in Alabama while promising the same. Live list prices did not move: 70 confirms, 0 ticks and 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $3.99 and Crusoe's 1 December rates still scheduled, not live.

item.title: Compute brief - 5 November 2026
item.description: Two days after US voters backed data center restrictions in 40 of 41 local ballot measures, the market repriced the build: Reuters reported the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 8% on Thursday, with CoreWeave down 11% and Nebius 15%. Texas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa said she will keep the state's pause in place until the legislature passes local votes, no-NDA rules and ratepayer protections; BMI says 53% of hyperscaler pipeline growth sits in newly flipped governor states, and Cleanview counts 159 GW, or 41% of planned US capacity, where new governors back a pause. Builders are answering with terms: OpenAI pledged to drop NDAs and pay its full power cost, and Lambda named itself anchor of a $33.1 billion, 1 GW campus in Alabama while promising the same. Live list prices did not move: 70 confirms, 0 ticks and 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $3.99 and Crusoe's 1 December rates still scheduled, not live. Countries: United States: Texas governor-elect will keep the data center pause until new laws pass; BMI puts 53% of hyperscale pipeline growth in newly flipped governor states (Wire, 5 Nov, corroborated). United States: Restrictions won 40 of 41 local ballot measures; OpenAI publishes a Compute Campus Policy and community compact (Wire, 5 Nov). United States: Lambda anchors a $33.1 billion, 1 GW Lowndes County, Alabama campus; construction from Q1 2027, first operations Q4 2028 (Wire, 4 Nov). United States: Microsoft declines an option of roughly 500 MW to expand its Nscale Texas contract; Nscale says its $103 billion backlog is unchanged (Wire, 5 Nov, FT-led). Malaysia: Princeton Digital Group raises about $1.3 billion of green financing for its 200 MW JH1 campus in Johor (Wire, 5 Nov). India: IndiaAI's 10,000-GPU empanelment round halves the entry bar to 512 units; bids close 13 November (Wire, 5 Nov, single-source).
